_notes: This is what the agent writes after observing the form, BEFORE it derives profile.json from it.
required is the marker on the page; emptyBlocksSubmit is the measured behaviour. The gap between them is the knowledge worth keeping.
categoryTree is read panel by panel, leaves included: it is the only thing that can answer 'did the platform add or remove a node'.
role marks the fields the profile refers to (name, category, scope, specName) so the consistency check never has to guess by label text.
One dump per board, named with its capture time, so boards can be compared against their own history.
optional records whether a slot may stay empty; whether 主图 blocks an empty upload is measured by submitting, not read off a label.
skuColumns lists every header cell in order, including the label column and the image column: filling by index counts all of them.
diff_probe.py refuses a pair of different boards without --cross-board, and refuses a pair with the same capturedAt - neither can answer 'did the platform change'.
No credentials, ever: diff_probe.py refuses a dump containing a key that looks like one.
